title: Keng tabassum
instruction: Keng tabassum qiling va 3 soniya ushlab turing. 5 marta takrorlang.

title: Qosh ko'tarish
instruction: Ikkala qoshingizni yuqoriga ko'taring va 3 soniya ushlab turing. 5 marta.

title: Ko'zni qattiq yumish
instruction: Ikkala ko'zingizni qattiq yuming va 3 soniya ushlab turing. 5 marta.

title: Lab cho'chchaytirish
instruction: Lablaringizni oldinga cho'chchaytiring va 3 soniya ushlab turing. 5 marta.

title: Lunj shishirish
instruction: Ikkala lunjingizni havo bilan shishiring va 3 soniya ushlab turing. 5 marta.
